full_judgment: 3. On 26th June, 1990 the petitioners filed an application praying for recording an order of abatement of the suit for the failure of the plaintiffs to bring the heirs of the deceased on record within the period of limitation. On behalf of the plaintiffs an application was thereafter made on 12th July, 1990 for addition of the heirs as defendants under Order 1 rule 10 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure stating, inter alia, that he had no knowledge about the death until the receipt of the application for recording abatement. Both the applications were set down for hearing on 1st September, 1990. On that date the learned Subordinate Judge, after hearing the parties, allowed the application of the plaintiffs but refused the prayer of the petitioners for recording an order of abatement of the suit.
